purpose: Cross-check the nine binomial source labels from Cabuga et al. (2020) against California Academy of Sciences Eschmeyer's Catalog of Fishes without treating nomenclature as specimen identification, local occurrence, or publication permission.

authority.name: Eschmeyer's Catalog of Fishes
authority.institution: California Academy of Sciences, Institute for Biodiversity Science and Sustainability
authority.accessMethod: Official catalog records were assessed using indexed snippets. Direct opens of selected exact-name pages returned 403 or were inaccessible; no login, challenge, or access control was bypassed.
authority.reuse: No item-specific republication license was verified. Only short attributed nomenclatural outcomes and links are retained; no bulk catalog data or distribution claims were copied.

interpretation.nomenclature: All nine source table binomials match names that the Catalog lists as valid in indexed catalog excerpts.
interpretation.specimenIdentity: This checks the names as labels only. No fish specimens, photographs, tissue, or voucher accessions were reidentified; field identification accuracy remains unresolved.
interpretation.localPresence: The Catalog is not evidence that any listed taxon currently occurs at a Lower Agusan station or in a specific waterbody.
interpretation.diet: This taxonomic review adds no natural-diet evidence. The source paper's trophic labels remain separate from prey observations and bait advice.
interpretation.distribution: Catalog distribution summaries were not used to infer Caraga presence or absence.
interpretation.publication: Nomenclatural status does not settle the source article's rights or approve app publication.

limitations: Catalog pages are dynamic and selected exact pages could not be opened directly; outcomes are based on indexed text snippets from the official Catalog.
A valid scientific name does not prove the study's field identification was correct.
No distribution summary is treated as a local occurrence or absence determination.
Reuse terms for republishing catalog text or source-derived app content were not established.
nextAction: Use the stabilized binomials for a bounded GBIF and museum-catalog voucher discovery screen with explicit station/locality variants. Deduplicate records against the same study, inspect basis of record, event date, institution/catalog identifiers, and georeference provenance; do not treat literature material citations or query zeroes as independent voucher evidence or fish absence.

references.supports: Catalog overview and official taxonomic authority identity.
